name: Enban Records
description: Enban Records — a WooCommerce store theme for an independent record shop where people listen before they buy. A docked black 40 px keyword bar ("On the desk this week") under a transparent overlay header; a hero with the headline beside an inset film-grain photograph card with a peeking next photo, square arrow tabs and square dots, and the shop day as a timeline band; centred section heads with a grey caps sub-label between full-width hairlines, a 330 x 55 outline box button with a chevron, and five-up square sleeve cards with a format disc, a bold price and a full-width outline status box. The home page continues with ruled audience rows, a horizontal four-stop listening line, the crate, a parallax counter band, the counter story, ranked stories on a lilac-grey band, the visit block and a dark Friday-letter band. Newsreader for headings, Literata for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. Calm entrance motion that respects reduced-motion.
